definitions.explanation: Being separated from someone, especially a loved one, with emotional weight. Implies a significant, often permanent separation.
The formal dissolution of a marriage or the act of husband and wife separating. A formal or literary alternative to {離婚|りこん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離別|りべつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つらい。
examples.english: Separation between parent and child is painful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{離別|りべつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was separated from my family by the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{離別|りべつ}し、⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: Separated from my mother at a young age, I was raised by my grandparents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離別|りべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{離別|りべつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親権|しんけん}→親権：14161_shinken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になった。
examples.english: After the divorce, child custody became an issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離別|りべつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{五歳|ごさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ときだった。
examples.english: My parents divorced when I was five years old.

notes:
Composed of {離|り} (separate, leave) + ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (part, divide). Carries a more emotional and literary tone than everyday words for separation or divorce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離別|りべつ}: separation from family
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離別|りべつ}: marital separation
- {離別|りべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to experience separation
- {離別|りべつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after the separation/divorce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別離|べつり}→別離：20188_betsuri⟧: parting, separation — more literary and poetic; emphasizes emotional pain
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧: divorce — the standard legal and everyday term for divorce
- ⟦{離散|りさん}→離散：14604_risan⟧: dispersal, scattering — used when family members are scattered to different places, often by war or disaster
- ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧: parting, farewell — the most common everyday word for parting

REGISTER:
Formal and somewhat literary. In everyday conversation, ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧ or ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧ would be more natural.
